about: Which fetched tariff documents (tools/fr/fetch.py output) are parsed, how, and what they cover. 'list' documents give one row per entry-exit pair with the five class prices in EUR including VAT (TTC). All the listed documents are priced together as one French system: a trip pays, in order along the route, for the longest entry-exit pairs these documents publish (tools/fr/build.py).

documents.covers: APRR network, with trips to and from A79 (ALIAE) through Deux-Chaises
A41 Nord (Liane), with trips to and from AREA
A79 free flow and the Deux-Chaises barrier, with trips to and from APRR
